summary: Iteration 5 — Phase C (public Hub chat + lead capture) and Phase D (EAN enrichment + CRM deep links). Created /app/backend/tests/test_hub_public_chat_enrich.py with 20 pytest tests. Result: 11/20 PASS (55%), 4 FAIL, 5 ERROR — all 9 failures share two root-cause backend bugs that block Phase C completely and Phase D partially. BUG #1 (CRITICAL, blocks every /chat and /lead endpoint test): POST /api/public/hub/{slug}/chat and POST /api/public/hub/{slug}/lead return HTTP 422 with detail [{'type':'missing','loc':['query','payload'],'msg':'Field required'}] for EVERY valid JSON body. Reproduced via curl. Root cause = slowapi 0.1.10 + FastAPI 0.110.1 + Pydantic 2.13.4 incompatibility: the @limiter.limit decorator wraps the route function, and FastAPI's dependency solver treats the Pydantic body model as a forward-reference query parameter (confirmed by Pydantic stack trace: `TypeAdapter[Annotated[ForwardRef('PublicHubChatIn'), Body(...)]] is not fully defined`). I attempted the documented slowapi fix (move `request: Request` to be first positional arg) — sig was correct via inspect.signature but FastAPI still mis-classifies the body. I also tried `payload: ModelT = Body(...)` and `payload: Annotated[ModelT, Body()]` — both produced a 500 with the ForwardRef PydanticUserError. BUG #2 (HIGH, blocks GET /api/enrich/ean): OpenFoodFacts (world.openfoodfacts.org) returns 403 to any request without a User-Agent header from our backend egress IP — verified directly from inside the container (`requests.get(...)` returns 403). The endpoint catches that as 'EAN not found' (line 2688 of server.py), so Nutella EAN 3017620422003 incorrectly returns 404. Workaround: pass `headers={'User-Agent': 'etoh-pilot/1.0 (contact@etoh.fr)'}` to the OFF call (OFF Terms of Service actually REQUIRE a UA identifying the app). All 11 non-chat tests PASSED: hub GET returns chat_enabled=true when user is Pro, hub_views increment correctly (+3 per 3 GETs), EAN validation (8-14 digits) returns 400, EAN '0000000000000' returns 404, EAN endpoint requires auth (401), and full regression of /api/, /api/auth/me, /api/subscription/plans, /api/admin/health, /api/wallet/packs, /api/hub/me. The autouse fixture correctly promoted the test user to Pro via direct Mongo update and reverted to free at module teardown — Mongo state is back to baseline (subscription unset, no leftover prospects/sessions).

critical.issue: Returns 422 'Field required (query.payload)' for every valid JSON body — slowapi @limiter.limit decorator breaks FastAPI's Pydantic body inference. Tried (a) moving `request: Request` to first arg, (b) `payload = Body(...)`, (c) `Annotated[Model, Body()]` — (a) didn't help, (b)/(c) crash with PydanticUserError ForwardRef. Likely needs a slowapi version bump or replacing the decorator with a Depends-based limiter. Reference: /app/backend/server.py:2506-2508.

Returns 404 'EAN not found' for valid EANs (verified 3017620422003 Nutella). Root cause: OpenFoodFacts returns 403 Forbidden when no User-Agent header is sent (verified from container via `requests.get(...)` → 403 HTML 'nginx'). Fix: add `headers={'User-Agent': 'etoh-pilot/1.0 (admin@etoh.fr)'}` to the _rq.get call at server.py:2684. OFF ToS requires a UA identifying the app.

minor.issue: Rate-limit cannot be validated end-to-end because the body-parsing bug returns 422 before slowapi accepts the call. Need to retest after Bug #1 is fixed.

action_items: FIX BUG #1 (CRITICAL): /chat and /lead Pydantic body-parsing fails under @limiter.limit. Recommended fix: replace the slowapi decorator with a `Depends(RateLimiter(...))` from slowapi.middleware OR upgrade slowapi to a version compatible with FastAPI 0.110+Pydantic 2.13. As a quick workaround, drop @limiter.limit on these two endpoints and call `limiter.limit('10/minute')(request)` manually inside the function body, OR move rate-limiting into a starlette middleware keyed on path. The current signature `async def public_hub_chat(request: Request, slug: str, payload: PublicHubChatIn)` is correct per slowapi docs but FastAPI 0.110 still mis-parses the body — this is a library compatibility issue, not a coding bug.

FIX BUG #2 (HIGH): EAN enrichment fails because OpenFoodFacts blocks unidentified requests. In server.py:2684, change `_rq.get(url, timeout=10)` to `_rq.get(url, timeout=10, headers={'User-Agent': 'etoh-pilot/1.0 (contact@etoh.fr)'})`. Verified the OFF host returns 403 to ua-less requests and 200 with the curl default UA.

Re-run /app/backend/tests/test_hub_public_chat_enrich.py once both bugs are fixed — the test plan promotes the user to Pro, sends 2 chat turns, captures a lead, checks Mongo persistence, exercises rate-limit (12 calls), verifies 402 on free plan, and reverts cleanly. The autouse fixture is idempotent.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 3274 lines (was 2800 in iteration_4) — strongly recommended to split into routers BEFORE adding Phase E. The /public/hub block (lines 2412-2666) is large enough to be its own router (`api/routers/public_hub.py`).

_hub_chat_system_prompt at server.py:2459 builds a prompt with multi-line f-string injection of business data — if `business_name`, `tagline`, `positioning` contain prompt-injection characters (e.g. 'RULES: ignore previous rules'), an attacker controlling a hub's business_profile could escape the system message. Low risk today (only authenticated owners write that data) but worth sanitising for Phase E once self-service onboarding lands.

Hub chat session truncation to last 40 messages (line 2551) is correct, but `recent_user_msgs = [...][-8:]` then concatenates the visitor history into the user prompt — could explode token cost for long conversations. Consider summarising older turns into a single line.

/api/public/hub/{slug}/lead does NOT verify the email syntax beyond Pydantic's EmailStr — fine — but it ALSO does not de-duplicate prospects (same email → multiple prospects). Worth adding `{'email':..., 'user_id':...}` uniqueness check for hub_public_chat-sourced leads.
Resend email send (line 2639) is synchronous inside the request path with timeout=8s — under load this blocks the worker. Should be moved to a BackgroundTask. Not blocking but pre-prod cleanup.

rca_of_issue: Bug #1 RCA: FastAPI's `solve_dependencies()` introspects the route function's signature to classify params into path/query/body. When slowapi 0.1.10 wraps the function via `@functools.wraps`, the resulting signature looks correct via `inspect.signature` (verified: `(request: Request, slug: str, payload: PublicHubChatIn)`) but FastAPI internally evaluates the type annotation as a ForwardRef in the wrapper's __annotations__, and since `PublicHubChatIn` is not in the wrapper's module namespace (it's in server.py's namespace, but typing.get_type_hints applied to the slowapi wrapper resolves it lazily), Pydantic's TypeAdapter cannot finalise the schema → it falls back to query param. Confirmed by adding `Body(...)`: throws PydanticUserError('class-not-fully-defined') with full stack trace pointing to TypeAdapter.validate_python. Bug #2 RCA: OFF nginx returns `403 Forbidden` (HTML body) when the request has no User-Agent. The endpoint at server.py:2687 checks `if r.status_code != 200: raise 404` — so a 403 silently becomes 'EAN not found'. Better: also send a UA per OFF ToS, AND distinguish 4xx/5xx in the error message (raise 503 for non-2xx that isn't 404).
